description: i008 (SNAPSHOT=s02, af-packet-tpacket-rings) complete. Finding (medium confidence): net/packet/af_packet.c tpacket_snd(), lines 2671-2682 validated against later independent consumption — `vnet_hdr = data;` aliases the payload of a TX_RING frame selected by packet_current_frame(po, &po->tx_ring, TP_STATUS_SEND_REQUEST) (line 2655) inside the mmap'd TPACKET ring; `__packet_snd_vnet_parse(vnet_hdr, tp_len)` (line 2676, helper at 2416-2427) validates hdr_len/csum bounds, then line 2680-2681 re-fetches vnet_hdr->hdr_len from the same shared memory to compute copylen for skb allocation, and lines 2719-2723 pass the same shared pointer to virtio_net_hdr_to_skb()/virtio_net_hdr_set_proto(), which re-read flags/gso_type/gso_size/hdr_len/csum_start/csum_offset into skb state (include/linux/virtio_net.h:50-70 -> skb_shinfo gso_size/gso_type, skb_partial_csum_set -> skb->csum_start/csum_offset). No READ_ONCE, local struct copy, or lock between fetches; a racing unprivileged userspace write to the ring can make the consumed values differ from the validated ones, breaking the validated-equals-used invariant for the same csum_start/csum_offset fields as the XSK seed. Counterevidence recorded: virtio_net_hdr_to_skb re-validates its own fetched values, partially bounding OOB impact, so the defect is the double-fetch/inconsistency (copylen vs hdr_len vs checksum offsets) rather than an unbounded OOB. Contrast case proving the pattern is recognized upstream: packet_snd() (line 2848, copy_from_iter_full at 2439) copies the header to a kernel-local struct. Rejected with evidence: tpacket_parse_header (2527) single-fetches tp_len/tp_mac/tp_net and returns checked locals; tpacket_rcv (2252) only writes ring fields, offsets kernel-computed; TPACKET_V3 block walking trusts kernel-side nxt_offset/kblk_size, never userspace tp_next_offset; poll (4123) uses tp_status for readiness only; packet_diag.c reads no user-mapped fields. Limitations: only net/packet audited; adjacent ring consumers outside net/packet not examined. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i008.json with snapshots_checked=["s02"].
